```{r}
#| label: setup
root <- normalizePath(here::here())
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "setup.R"))

if (!exists("SRS_UNITS", inherits = FALSE)) SRS_UNITS <- "mm"
SelectionTable <- .srsDeckSelections(
  params, root,
  path = if (exists("PathSRS", inherits = FALSE)) PathSRS else NULL
)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
for (i in seq_len(nrow(SelectionTable))) {
  PathSRS <- SelectionTable$PathSRS[[i]]
  .srsMissing <- function(x) !length(x) || is.na(x) || !nzchar(as.character(x))
  .srsText <- function(x) if (.srsMissing(x)) "not available" else as.character(x)
  .srsNum <- function(x, digits) {
    if (.srsMissing(x)) return("not available")
    prettyNum(round(as.numeric(x), digits), big.mark = ",", nsmall = digits)
  }
  .srsMagnitude <- function(x) {
    M <- .srsNum(x$EventMagnitude, 2L)
    T <- .srsText(x$EventMagnitudeType)
    if (M == "not available" && T == "not available") return("magnitude not available")
    if (T == "not available") return(sprintf("M %s", M))
    if (M == "not available") return(T)
    sprintf("%s %s", T, M)
  }
  .srsPGA <- function(x) {
    if (.srsMissing(x)) return("not available")
    sprintf("%.3f g", as.numeric(x) / 9806.65)
  }
  .srsCaptionRow <- function(recordID) {
    X <- CaptionTable[RecordID == as.character(recordID) & OCID == "H1"]
    if (nrow(X) != 1L) stop(sprintf("SRS caption inputs have no single H1 row for %s.", recordID), call. = FALSE)
    X
  }
  .srsRecordText <- function(recordID) {
    X <- .srsCaptionRow(recordID)
    sprintf(
      "record %s (%s; %s; Repi = %s km; Vs30 = %s m/s; matched PGA = %s)",
      recordID,
      .srsText(X$EventName),
      .srsMagnitude(X),
      .srsNum(X$Repi, 1L),
      .srsNum(X$StationVs30, 0L),
      .srsPGA(X$PGA)
    )
  }
  .srsItsCaption <- function(recordID) sprintf(
    "Matched acceleration time history for %s. The solid line is the matched H1 component; dashed/dotted lines show retained VMD modal contributions.",
    .srsRecordText(recordID)
  )
  .knitSelectionBlock(
    path = "/_revealjs/srs.its.qmd",
    stem = "srs-its",
    selections = SelectionTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(TITLE = sprintf(
        "Selected Ground-Motion Suite%s<br>Retained VMD Modal Time Histories",
        if (nrow(SelectionTable) > 1L) {
          sprintf(" — %s", SelectionTable$label[[i]])
        } else {
          ""
        }
      )),
    root = root,
    context = "SRS ITS deck"
  )
}
```

  "META_FILE", "IMW_FILE", "FILE", "CAPTION_DUP",
  "MISSING_CAPTIONS", "MISS", "PLOT",
  ".srsMissing", ".srsText", ".srsNum", ".srsMagnitude", ".srsPGA",

), ls()))
